aism_behavior: class-driven (no AISM counterpart -- AISM's argument.py has no signature vocabulary, no convention profile, and no regime reasoning of any kind).
notes: Check 17(c), closed vocabulary, key half: 'sparsity' is not in the profile, so it has no declared order -- there is no rule by which it could be compared. An undeclared key must be an ERROR and never merely 'unmet': reported as unmet it would read as a substantive regime clash, and silently ignored it would let an author express any constraint they liked and have it checked by nothing.
